newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANSKE BANK OPENS HELSINKI BRANCH.
newsitem.headline: DANSKE BANK OPENS HELSINKI BRANCH.

text.p: Denmark's biggest bank Den Danske Bank said it officially opened on Monday a new branch in Helsinki, Finland with a 30-strong staff.
It said the new branch would primarily service Finnish business clients and that the event would be marked by a reception at Finland's National Museum in Helsinki on Monday.
Danske Bank opened a representative office in Helsinki in 1995, achieving primary dealer status for Finnish state bonds on on the local stock exchange in the following year.

It said in a statement that the opening of the new branch was part its policy of strengthening its position in the Nordic region. Danske Bank has already branch offices in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmo in Sweden and plans to open in Oslo, Norway in the coming months, it said.
